product.name: Anker 100W / 140W GaN Multi-Port Charger
product.audience: Business travelers, MacBook users, remote workers, students, and multi-device digital workers who want one compact charger for laptop, phone, tablet, earbuds, and travel
product.priceRange: Premium accessory; expected EUR 60-120 depending on wattage and bundle
product.positioning: A compact high-power USB-C GaN charger that replaces multiple original adapters for work, school, and travel
sellingPoints: Multiple ports for laptop, phone, and accessories
Smaller travel footprint than carrying several original chargers

trend.name: Multi-device work and travel charging / GaN fast charging
trend.platform: Google Search / YouTube / tech reviews / ecommerce
trend.description: USB-C standardization, laptop USB-C charging, remote work, travel, and multi-device setups are making compact multi-port high-power GaN chargers a practical replacement for carrying several original adapters.
trend.drivenBy: USB-C regulation, laptop and phone convergence, business travel, remote work, creator workstations, and tech-review buying guides
trend.format: What's in my travel tech bag, one charger for my MacBook and phone, desk setup cleanup, EU USB-C travel kit, replacing three chargers with one
trend.whyPopular: People carry more USB-C devices and want fewer power bricks, especially when moving between home, office, airport, hotel, and client meetings.
trend.exampleContent: A traveler charges a MacBook, iPhone, and earbuds from one compact Anker GaN charger in an airport lounge and hotel room.
trend.controversy: Hardware risk is mostly compliance, heat, plug stability, cable wattage confusion, and premium price pressure from cheaper GaN competitors.
